idea-plugin.name: MTG Agent Visualizer
idea-plugin.description:
Visualize your AI agents as Magic: The Gathering cards!

This plugin parses AI agent definitions from your codebase and renders each agent as a visually accurate MTG card — complete with AI-generated artwork, mana cost, abilities, flavor text, and a "Battlefield" relationship board showing the full agent graph.

Features:

  • Right-click any agent file → "Visualize as MTG Card"
  • Battlefield view showing all agents and their relationships
  • AI-generated card art (Local SD, Stability AI, or bundled fallbacks)
  • Standard and borderless (alt-art) card styles
  • Automatic agent relationship detection

Art Generation Options:

  • Local Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111 or ComfyUI)
  • Stability AI cloud API (bring your own key)
  • Bundled fallback art (works out of the box)

Supported Agent Formats:

  • Markdown with YAML frontmatter
  • LangChain / LangGraph
  • OpenAI Agents SDK
  • CrewAI
